preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have been authorized by the owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the setBotBlacklist() function with the target contract address and set the flag to true. This will blacklist the contract, preventing it from making transactions. The exploit demonstrates the owner's ability to arbitrarily block any address from transacting.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has a setBotBlacklist() function that is only callable by the owner (via onlyOwner modifier). This function can blacklist any address, which will prevent that address from sending or receiving tokens (as checked in _transferFrom()). The vulnerability demonstrates that the owner has excessive power to arbitrarily block any address from transacting, which could be abused to freeze funds or disrupt normal contract operations.
attempts.attack_strategy: Since the attacker needs to be the owner, we'll use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner address. We'll call setBotBlacklist() on the target contract with the victim contract address and set the flag to true. This will update the blacklist mapping for the victim address to true.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Identify the owner address of the contract
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call setBotBlacklist(victimAddress, true) on the target contract
4. Verify that blacklist[victimAddress] is now true

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract inherits from Ownable which stores the owner at storage slot 0. We can directly overwrite this slot to make ourselves the owner, then call setBotBlacklist().
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Use vm.store() to overwrite the owner storage slot at TARGET contract to make address(this) the owner. 2. Call setBotBlacklist() directly as the new owner. 3. Verify the blacklist was set.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Calculate the storage slot for the owner (slot 0 in Ownable). 2. Use vm.store() to set owner to address(this). 3. Call setBotBlacklist(victimAddress, true). 4. Verify blacklist[victimAddress] == true.
attempts.failure_reflection: The error was due to RPC rate limiting when trying to fetch the owner address. We need a more robust approach that doesn't rely on RPC calls that might fail. We can use storage slot manipulation to become the owner first.
